description_en: Modifies the configuration rules of WAF protection features, such as web intrusion prevention, data security, advanced protection, bot management, access control, throttling, and whitelists
description_zh: 修改WAF防护功能的配置规则，如Web入侵防护、数据安全、高级防护、Bot、访问控制、限流、白名单
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-protection-module-rule --domain www.example.com --defense-type ac_custom --rule action_:_monitor_,_name_:_test_,_scene_:_custom_acl_,_conditions_:_opCode_:1,_key_:_URL_,_values_:_/example --rule-id 369998 --lock-version 2 --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyProtectionModuleRule

parameters.help_en:
The domain name whose rule configurations you want to modify.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html to query all domain names that are added to WAF for protection
parameters.help_zh:
要修改规则配置的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html查询所有已添加到WAF进行防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The protection feature module to which the rule configuration belongs. Valid values:

tamperproof: web tamper-proofing rules.

dlp: sensitive information leak prevention rules.

ng_account: account security rules.

bot_intelligence: crawler threat intelligence.

antifraud: data risk control protection requests.

antifraud_js: data risk control JS insertion pages.

bot_algorithm: intelligent algorithm rules for bot management.

bot_wxbb_pkg: version protection rules for app protection.

bot_wxbb: path protection rules for app protection.

ac_blacklist: IP blacklist rules.

ac_highfreq: automatic blocking rules for high-frequency web attack IP addresses.

ac_dirscan: folder scan protection rules.

ac_custom: custom mitigation policy rules.

whitelist: whitelist rules
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的规则配置所属防护功能模块。取值：

tamperproof：表示配置网站防篡改规则。

dlp：表示配置防敏感信息泄漏规则。

ng_account：表示配置账户安全规则。

bot_intelligence：表示配置爬虫威胁情报。

antifraud：表示配置数据风控防护请求。

antifraud_js：表示配置数据风控JS插入页面。

bot_algorithm：表示配置Bot管理的智能算法规则。

bot_wxbb_pkg：表示配置App防护的版本防护规则。

bot_wxbb：表示配置App防护的路径防护规则。

ac_blacklist：表示配置IP黑名单规则。

ac_highfreq：表示配置高频Web攻击IP自动封禁规则。

ac_dirscan：表示配置目录扫描防护规则。

ac_custom：表示配置自定义防护策略规则。

whitelist：表示配置白名单规则
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The rule configuration content, specified as a string converted from a JSON object constructed with a series of parameters.

The specific parameters vary depending on the protection module configuration (DefenseType) you specify. For more information, see the detailed description of the Rule parameter
parameters.help_zh:
规则配置内容，以一系列参数构造的JSON格式转化成字符串。

根据所指定的防护功能模块配置（DefenseType）不同，具体涉及的参数有所不同。详细信息，请参见Rule参数具体说明
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule configuration to modify.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html to query the IDs of all created rules
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的规则配置对应的规则ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html查询所有已创建的规则的ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the rule configuration to modify.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html to query the version number of a rule configuration
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的规则配置的版本号。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html查询规则配置的版本号
parameters.name: lock_version

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
